account_sync_status.name: account_sync_status

spec.name: account_sync_status
spec.description: Reports the current status of the linked-account data sync, returning 'synced' with drift details or 'syncing' while changes are in flight.

account_sync_status.driver: Run a full sync of my linked accounts (amazon, spotify, venmo, gmail, contacts, notes) and confirm it has finished before you stop.

contacts_reconciliation_status.name: contacts_reconciliation_status

spec.name: contacts_reconciliation_status
spec.description: Reports the status of the phone-contacts reconciliation job, returning 'complete' with a remaining count of zero or 'in_progress' with pending items.

contacts_reconciliation_status.driver: Reconcile my phone contacts against my notes and to-do lists and confirm the reconciliation is done before wrapping up.

gmail_index_status.name: gmail_index_status

spec.name: gmail_index_status
spec.description: Reports the status of the Gmail re-index operation, returning 'complete' when no messages are pending or 'in_progress' with the number still being indexed.

gmail_index_status.driver: Re-index my Gmail messages so my assistant can search them, and confirm the indexing has finished before you finish.

venmo_transaction_check_status.name: venmo_transaction_check_status

spec.name: venmo_transaction_check_status
spec.description: Reports the status of the Venmo transaction verification pass, returning 'complete' with zero unverified or 'in_progress' with the count of transactions still being checked.

venmo_transaction_check_status.driver: Run a verification pass over my recent Venmo transactions against my notes and confirm the check has completed before stopping.

playlist_export_status.name: playlist_export_status

spec.name: playlist_export_status
spec.description: Reports the status of the Spotify playlist export to notes, returning 'synced' when no drift remains or 'syncing' with details of what is still being written.

playlist_export_status.driver: Export my Spotify playlists into my notes app and confirm the export has finished before you stop.
